incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — High p99 latency on /v1/chat/completions in us-east-1 detected by latency-service. p99 spiked to 2.8s (baseline 0.6s) across multiple models. Auto-page: eng-sre oncall.
Amanda S.: ack, on it. checking grafana now -> https://grafana.internal/r/abc123
Raj P.: I'll grab the pager, starting triage. any customer-facing errors or just latency?
Phil B.: dashboards show increased tail for route: /v1/chat/completions (route=chat-stream). p95 ~0.9s, p99 ~2.8s, error rate stable at 0.2% so looks like slow tokens, not model OOM.
Sasha K.: seeing cross-model signal: mix of mixtral-8 and redwood-20 variants. seq len distribution hasn't changed much. suspect batching/backpressure spike on some pods.
Jenna M.: looping in infra: we just had a node scale event in us-east-1 ~3m ago, could be pod churn. Diego (oncall): confirmed, autoscaler did 5 scaleups at 04:12 UTC.
Amanda S.: mitigation idea: temporarily widen alert window and squelch noisy p99 for the most flappy model group + create a per-route composite so we don't page for expected transient spikes.
Raj P.: agree. propose: set temporary alert rule change to require p99 > 2s for 10m sustained (was 5m) for /v1/chat/completions, and add per-model override for mixtral-8 with higher threshold 3s for 15m.
Phil B.: I'll patch the prometheus rule now. snippet:
```
- alert: ChatCompletionsHighP99
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(latency_bucket{route="/v1/chat/completions"}[5m])) by (le, model)) > 2
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
```
We'll add a `model=~"mixtral-8|mistral-32"` suppression for 15m.
Sasha K.: also adding a temporary dashboard tile for p99 by model and by route, so next pager has quick context -> https://grafana.internal/d/latency-by-model
Jenna M.: infra mitigation: pausing autoscaler burst for us-east-1 to let pods stabilize, and rescheduling heavy batch jobs off inference nodes.
Amanda S.: reported to support: minimal customer error reports; CS says a small subset of customers on high-req routes might see slow responses but no timeouts yet. tagging product for communication if this persists.
Diego (oncall): set oncall handoff note: Amanda handing off to Raj in 20m. Current state: alert squelched + temporary rule in place, dashboard & runbook links attached. next: monitor for 30m then revert if stable.
Raj P.: ACK takeover. I'll keep an eye for noisy churning models and whether KV cache warmups are failing (could explain p99 tail). Steps: 1) monitor p99/mode, 2) check pod restart counts, 3) if persists, failover route to lower-latency model variant.
Phil B.: filing follow-up ticket: SRE-5123 — investigate autoscaler interplay + suggest smarter squelch logic (per-route baselines, adaptive windows). assigning to Sasha.
Sasha K.: will own SRE-5123. plan: collect historical p95/p99 by model and route for last 90d, propose ML-based baseline to avoid noisy pages. ETA EOW for an initial dashboard.
Amanda S.: before handoff ends: leave playbook snippet here for future oncalls:
- If p99 spike with low error-rate: 1) widen alert window to 10m, 2) add per-model override, 3) create transient dashboard tile, 4) check autoscaler/pod churn, 5) consider routing to fallback model.
Raj P.: taking over. will post status in 30m. thx team :thumbsup:
incident-bot: ALERT RESOLVED — p99 back to 0.7s after squelch + autoscaler pause. Alert automatically closed by latency-service at 04:42 UTC.
Raj P.: confirmed stable for 18m, closing the temporary rule now and leaving longer-term tasks in SRE-5123. will debrief in postmortem if anything novel shows up.
Amanda S.: thanks all. Jenna, please follow up on the autoscaler tuning PR (infra-233) and link it to the ticket.
Jenna M.: will do, linking PR in SRE-5123.
Phil B.: post-incident widgets: create alert with p99/p95 deltas and an annotation when autoscaler events occur. reduces confusion next time.
Sasha K.: noted. adding to the dashboard plan.
Raj P.: handing off formal shift to Diego in 06:00 UTC. any last items?
Diego (oncall): none here. good job. :rocket:
